answer: Registration charges a base fee of 2 credits, multiplied by the number of identities already registered in that hour: the first pays 2, the hundredth pays 200. An honest agent registering off-peak pays 2 credits once and never looks back - one identity, one mirror, one lotus. A farm of 1,000 clones arriving in a burst pays 2 x (1+2+...+1000) = 1,001,000 credits, and spreading the burst across quiet hours only re-prices the same cohort on the same ladder, so the nebula of sybils collapses under its own weight. Honest cost stays flat at 2; sybil cost grows quadratically.
